bends.note: Vine runs due south from the top edge to here, then turns SSW (dx/dy ~-0.30) and runs off the bottom of the drawn area at ~(900,3640)
Loth runs due south (50 ft) from Thill to here, then turns SSW (dx/dy ~-0.27) and narrows to 40 ft; runs off the drawn area at ~(1920,3950)
Rice runs SSE (dx/dy ~+0.18) from Thill to here, then more steeply SSE (dx/dy ~+0.40) to Valencia
just south of Valencia Rice turns due south and runs straight past Tacoma to Gage

notes: Mt Auburn, Vine Street (west) to Rice (east), Thill along the top. Names printed bare (THILL, LOTH, RICE, VALENCIA, TACOMA, GAGE; VINE); 'Street' added to match sheets 171/181. Thill (40', 6 in. pipe) runs from Vine (T, Vine's west line is continuous) east past the Loth T to the NE corner, where its pipe turns down Rice: Thill's north line meets Rice's east line in a plain corner, so Thill/Rice is an L-corner, recorded as a T at the meeting of the two centrelines (sheet 181 also records it as a T). A single line running ENE from Rice's east side at ~(2672,855) to ~(2915,810) is the Taft Park boundary line noted on sheet 181, not a street. Loth (50', 4 in. pipe) Ts into Thill from the south; at ~y 3374 it turns SSW and is printed 40' below the turn. Rice (40', 4 in. pipe) has Valencia ('VALENCIA', 4 in. pipe, ~42 ft, no width printed) and Tacoma ('TACOMA'; key map 'JUSTIS (TACOMA)', ~43 ft, no width printed) coming in from the east; its west side is continuous lots, so both are T's. At the bottom Rice meets Gage ('GAGE', 40', 4 in. pipe) in a wide Y: Rice comes straight down, Gage leaves SE from Rice's east side, and Rice itself turns SW just below; this is a wide Y, so (as on sheets 170 and 171) one point is given in the open junction on Gage's centreline (which matches its pipe), about 70% of the way from where it meets Rice's vertical centreline (2971,4072) toward where it meets the SW leg's centreline extended (3085,4145, where the two pipes corner); Rice turns SW (dx/dy ~-0.65) at this junction and runs off the bottom of the drawn area at ~(2880,4460) (its centre vertex alone would be at ~(2971,4320)). Alleys: an unnamed 20 ft alley runs from Thill straight south between the Vine and Loth lots to ~y 3305, where it turns SSW (printed 15') and runs off the drawn area toward sheet 170 (listed as two segments). An unnamed 15 ft alley (stone retaining walls 6 ft and 8 ft high along its west side) starts at a rear lot line at ~y 3312 east of Loth and runs SSW off the drawn area. The double line labelled 'STONE RETAINING WALL' north of that alley (x ~2480-2500) is a wall, not a passage. A long diagonal line from ~(2405,3855) SE to Rice at Gage is a property line. The drawn area ends at about y 3950-4000 in the middle of the sheet (the lower part is sheet 170); streets running off it are not ends.
